entities.name: Thassa
entities.description: The God of the Sea on Theros, associated with blue mana and with gradual change, ancient knowledge and introspection.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: The plane where Thassa is a god.

entities.name: Meletis
entities.description: A polis where Thassa is particularly worshipped.

entities.name: Heliod
entities.description: God who considers Thassa his favorite sibling.

entities.name: Purphoros
entities.description: God who gave Thassa a new divine spear.

entities.name: Dekella
entities.description: Thassa's bident, a divine weapon that could stir the seas and summon whirlpools; later stolen by Kiora.

entities.name: Silence of the Gods
entities.description: Event that temporarily prevented divine influence over mortal affairs.

entities.name: Lyokymion
entities.description: Week-long new year festival celebrating the sea's bounty and Thassa's grace.

events.summary: A mortal steals Dekella to destroy a rival fleet and Thassa turns his family into eels (legend).
events.quote: Thassa turned his family into eels

events.summary: Kiora steals Dekella and Thassa receives a new divine spear from Purphoros.
events.quote: Dekella was later stolen by the planeswalker Kiora

events.summary: Thassa is affected by the Silence of the Gods.
events.quote: was affected by the Silence of the Gods
